text: グリーンバッジさえ　あれば　どんなに　レベルの　たかい　ポケモンも　いうことを　きく！

structure.jp: グリーンバッジさえ　あれば
structure.en: as long as you have the Earth Badge

structure.jp: どんなに　レベルの　たかい　ポケモンも
structure.en: any Pokémon, however high its level

patterns.name: 〜さえ〜ば
patterns.span: グリーンバッジさえ　あれば
patterns.explanation: さえ with a ば 'if' form says 'if only this one thing is there, that is enough'. グリーンバッジさえ　あれば = 'as long as you have the Earth Badge'

patterns.name: どんなに〜も
patterns.span: どんなに　レベルの　たかい　ポケモンも
patterns.explanation: どんなに 'however much' together with a later も says 'no matter how..., even then'. どんなに　レベルの　たかい　ポケモンも = 'even a Pokémon however high its level'

patterns.name: 〜の (subject)
patterns.span: レベルの　たかい　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: Inside a phrase that describes a thing, の can stand in for が. レベルの　たかい　ポケモン = 'a Pokémon whose level is high'
